verdict_reason: The new tests cover 502/503/504 and a dropped connection correctly, but the 'any other status' test only sends 401, leaving a token 500 unproved, and the Feign failure set-up is copied across three test classes.

todos.issue: apply_rethrowsTheTokenEndpointsError_whenItAnswersAnyOtherStatus claims every status other than 502, 503 and 504, but the body only sends a 401. The case that matters most, a token endpoint 500, is not checked here or in TokenEndpointUnavailableIT (which only stubs 503). Widening the production check at MdmClientInterceptor.java:64 to ex.status() >= 500 would turn a token 500 into a 503 and leave this test green.
todos.fix: Must: the title claims only the statuses the test sends, and a token endpoint 500 is proved to come back as the same FeignException, not as TokenEndpointUnavailableException. One way: make it a @ParameterizedTest with @ValueSource(ints = {401, 500}), matching the unavailable-status test above it.

todos.issue: This PR writes the same Feign failure set-up by hand in three test classes. The six-argument RetryableException with -1, 'connection reset', new RuntimeException('reset') and 0L appears at MdmClientInterceptorTest.java:106 and MdmServiceTest.java:281, differing only in HTTP method and URL. The Request.create(...) and Response.builder() set-up at MdmClientInterceptorTest.java:131-150 repeats MdmErrorDecoderTest.java:40-52.
todos.fix: Must: one shared test helper builds the Feign request, status response and dropped-connection exception, and these three test classes call it with no local copies left. One way: add a FeignFailures test support class taking the method and URL, with status(...) and droppedConnection(...) methods.
